findings.title: `.small-action` flex container breaks right alignment of the action button
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, but its button still relies on `float: right` for alignment. Floats have no effect on flex items, so if the button is a direct child it will sit right after `.small-action-desc` instead of at the row's right edge. If the button is nested inside `.small-action-desc`, that desc is now a content-sized flex item rather than full width, so the float no longer reaches the container edge. The small-action button (e.g. undo/dismiss) will no longer be right-aligned. Add `margin-left: auto` to the button and/or allow `.small-action-desc` to grow (`flex: 1`).

findings.title: `align-items` mixin is missing `-moz-box-align` for the `-moz-box` fallback
findings.body: `flexbox()` and `inline-flex()` emit `display: -moz-box` / `-moz-inline-box`, so old Firefox versions use the 2009-spec flexbox. However `align-items()` emits `-webkit-box-align`, `-webkit-align-items`, `-ms-flex-align`, `-ms-align-items`, and `align-items`, but never `-moz-box-align`. In those Firefox versions, `align-items: center` and `align-items: baseline` are ignored, so header contents, `.small-action`, and `.badge-wrapper.bullet` will not be center/baseline aligned when the `-moz-box` fallback is active. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment;` to the mixin.
